note.label: Joshua 16: The Lot of the Children of Joseph

precepts.why:
The lot of the children of Joseph goes up through mount Bethel and “goeth out from Beth–el to Luz”. This is the same place where our forefather Jacob was, where he had the vision of the ladder that reached up into heaven. “And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it. And he called the name of that place Beth–el: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.”

So the Bethel and Luz in Joseph's lot are Jacob's Bethel and Luz. We are reading about it in Joshua where our forefather had already been to that location, and we are just going back to take it back. That is what we are doing.

points: The lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, up through mount Bethel, and goeth out from Bethel to Luz.

note.label: Joshua 16: The Lot of the Children of Joseph

points: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance. The border of the children of Ephraim by their families ran from Ataroth on the east, about eastward unto Taanathshiloh, down to Jericho and out at Jordan, and from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah, with the goings out thereof at the sea.

note.label: Joshua 16: The Lot of the Children of Joseph

points: There were also separate cities for the children of Ephraim among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

note.label: Joshua 16: The Lot of the Children of Joseph

points: They drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer, but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
Like the Jebusites among Judah, these were also forced to be under tribute, as our bondservants.
